messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging: Sev2 — multiple driver Xid/ECC errors observed on GPU nodes in us-west-2. Pager: anna (oncall). Please acknowledge.

anna (oncall): acknowledged. I’m on it. seeing spikes in driver resets and a couple of container crashes tied to runtime-serve.

lee (eng-sre): I’ve flagged 3 nodes in gpu-pool-west that showed `Xid 79` and `Xid 13` in dmesg. probable ECC/corruption.

tom (eng-runtime): thanks lee — are workloads failing requests or just recovering? logs?

lee (eng-sre): some pods restarted, a few 503s from the load balancer for ~30s windows. affected tenant: dedicated-cust-3 saw latency and 5xx errors.

joe (support): customer reports "inference timeouts" from ~14:22–14:27 UTC. opened support ticket; copying error IDs.

anna (oncall): taking lead. plan: cordon the 3 nodes, drain non-critical pods, move critical serving traffic to healthy pool, reboot nodes one at a time, collect full nvidia logs and ECC stats. any objections?

tom (eng-runtime): agree. also enable fallback routing to cheaper model variant for Dedicated traffic until nodes back. will flip routing policy in 5m.

lee (eng-sre): running: ```bash
for n in node-34 node-39 node-42; do kubectl cordon $n; kubectl drain $n --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data -l tier!=system; done
```
started drain on node-39 now.

infra-bot: node node-39 cordoned by lee at 2026-06-10T14:31:12Z. drain: 12 pods evicted.

anna (oncall): collecting `dmesg` and `nvidia-smi -q`. paste the snippets here.

lee (eng-sre): dmesg snippet: "NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 79, Xid 79" then repeated ECC errors. also: "NVRM: RmInitAdapter failed, device minor number 2"

lee (eng-sre): nvidia-smi -q shows ECC errors non-zero and GPU A trending high memory correctable errors.

tom (eng-runtime): can we confirm driver version and kernel? Might be the recent 535.x driver we rolled last week.

lee (eng-sre): driver 535.86, kernel 5.15.0-88. two of the nodes have slightly different microcode levels.

maya (product): have we estimated customer impact (requests failed, duration, LQ)?

joe (support): dedicated-cust-3: ~120 failed requests, peak error rate +25% for 5m. public-hosted API: minor blips, <0.5% errors.

anna (oncall): mitigation steps checklist: 1) drain + reboot node-39, collect full /var/log/nvidia-installer.log 2) keep node-34/42 cordoned until validated 3) shift traffic & enable runtime fallback 4) open hardware ticket with vendor if ECC persists. anyone take action 4?

tom (eng-runtime): I’ll flip fallback routing now (canary to adjacent region then model-variant fallback). doing: `rwctl route set --policy fallback --scope dedicated-cust-3`.

infra-bot: routing change queued by tom.

lee (eng-sre): rebooted node-39 (soft reboot). Watch logs.

anna (oncall): monitoring. attaching live log tail:```
[14:33:02] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 79, pid 12345, name python
[14:33:05] Container restart: runtime-serve-abc
env=production
[14:33:07] kernel: GPU reported ECC error: correctable=234 uncorrectable=2
```

lee (eng-sre): node-39 came back, but ECC uncorrectable count still >0. keeping cordoned.

joe (support): letting dedicated-cust-3 know we routed them to fallback model and are working on node remediation.

maya (product): please add incident note that SLA blip affected dedicated customers; support already prepping customer comms.

anna (oncall): creating short incident timeline and adding to post-incident. assigning follow-ups: verify driver/kernel compatibility (tom), hardware escalation (lee), customer comm draft (joe/maya).

tom (eng-runtime): quick check: I’m rolling back the driver to 535.80 on a single test node-44 in staging to reproduce. commands: ```bash
apt-get install nvidia-driver-535=535.80-0 -y
systemctl restart nvidia-persistenced
```

I’ll report if stable.

lee (eng-sre): I’m pulling serial logs and plan to reseat GPU on node-42 tomorrow if ECC persists after reboot. also opening support ticket with vendor: "HW-INC-2119".

anna (oncall): any immediate customer hotfixes?

tom (eng-runtime): short-term: keep fallback routing for dedicated-cust-3 for next 2 hours and enable extra retries at edge (backoff 100ms -> 200ms). will revert after green check.

joe (support): notified customer of mitigation and ETA for updates.

infra-bot: incident created: INC-2026-0610-03, severity: SEV2, owner: anna (oncall).

anna (oncall): handing off to daytime SRE (lee) at 14:45 UTC. I’ll remain in loop for postmortem.

lee (eng-sre): ack. continuing monitoring and hardware escalation. will update every 30m or on new Xid spike.

tom (eng-runtime): staging node-44 with older driver is stable for 12m now (no Xid). rolling a single prod test if lee gives go.

anna (oncall): go for single prod test on node-34 after lee confirms drain complete.

lee (eng-sre): drain complete on node-34. doing driver rollback on node-34 now. node-34 reboot scheduled.

anna (oncall): final note before handoff: keep incident window open until all 3 nodes validated and vendor ticket acknowledged. tagging postmortem owners: tom, lee, anna. :white_check_mark:
